title: Bold, Wildheart and Nocturne have whole-page Spotlight layouts (the six shared house layouts, each in its own tokens)

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Survey EVERY theme and make sure they have their full design system and all 4 parts, with all templates. Spotlight, Space, Website and Email templates."

detail: Survey 2026-11-18 (themes-complete-2026-11-18/SURVEY.md): Bold, Wildheart and Nocturne had only a Spotlight colour preset, no whole-page layouts. Rather than three more copies of a kit, one markup (components/spotlight/house-kit-layouts.tsx) and one sheet carry the six layouts (Stack, Card wall, Story, Calendar first, Shop front, Profile); each theme wears its own flat token set from lib/theme/mega-surfaces.ts as --hk-* properties plus a small presentation (faces, case, corners, frame). Preview copy coaches the owner (Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write"); a live page shows none of it and no invented price, time or quote. Member Spotlights draw a stored bold-kit/wildheart-kit/nocturne-kit layout. Spaces are opt-in: the Look picker leads with Blocks, so a Space already on one of these themes (House of Fates on Nocturne) keeps its block page until its owner picks a look. Three pins that said these themes have no layouts follow the survey ruling. The Spotlight preset label says Nocturne, never Midnight.
